historical_stage_policy.counting_rule: An era count includes only independent letter lineages. Merged roots keep earlier artwork and appear as a merger label in later cells. Modern glottal and click are special signs outside the 21 letters.
historical_stage_policy.merger_dates: Only 𓎱 → 𓆠 at the Traditional transition was specified; all other assignments remain proposals from the supplied chart.

special_sign_lineage.note: The two emphasis signs are descendants of the glottal stop, not independent Egyptian picture roots.

artwork_policy: Each active era cell uses the matching numbered SVG from the supplied 52-glyph era collection. Number N maps to ancestral root N. No post-merger SVGs are packaged or displayed.
